correctness.rationale: PASS: In full-reception regime direct averaging reduces exactly to x_i^+=mu+(c/n)g_i(x) with antisymmetric hostile orientation scores. Distinct output coordinates differ by at most (c/n)(d_i+d_j), so d_(1)+d_(2)<n is sufficient inductively. Putting a maximum-degree node highest and second-highest lowest in an initially sub-c interval makes the gap c(d_(1)+d_(2))/n, proving necessity including equality. The convex hostile-edge potential Q minus n/(2c) squared mean-deviation has strict increment >= n/(2c)||next-current||²; finitely many integer score vectors or oriented edge sets prohibit cycles and force a fixed point within min(2^m,product_i(d_i+1)) steps. Independently compared direct rational update to score map for every signed complete graph and strict initial order through n=5 and verified strict potential in all eligible cases (C2_OK).
